run_qa_beam_search_no_trainer_finetune: run the script to fine-tune XLNet for question answering with beam search using Accelerate without Trainer
run_qa_beam_search_no_trainer_train_eval: run the script with --do_train and --do_eval to fine-tune and evaluate XLNet QA model using beam search decoding
run_qa_beam_search_no_trainer_predict: run the script with --do_predict to generate question answering predictions on a test dataset using beam search
run_qa_beam_search_no_trainer_resume: run the script with --resume_from_checkpoint to continue training XLNet QA model from a saved checkpoint
run_qa_beam_search_no_trainer_push_hub: run the script with --push_to_hub to fine-tune XLNet QA and push the model to the Hugging Face Hub
